text:
Mike (Product): Quick heads up — planning to announce deprecation for the v1 Generate/Invoke endpoints next Tue. Need docs + migration examples by end of week. Is that feasible?

Jenny (Docs): I can own the migration guide. Plan: 1-page quickstart, JS/Python/cURL snippets, a short "what breaks" FAQ, and one runnable sample app. Will need eng to confirm breaking changes.

Ryan (Eng): Ping — main breaking bits: param rename `model_id` -> `model`; streaming callback shape changed (now emits `delta` chunks instead of `token` events); and the old `/v1/invoke` accepts legacy `input` vs new `messages` schema. I'll write a compatibility note and example shim.

Jenny (Docs): Perfect. Can you paste minimal before/after examples? I want them concise.

Ryan (Eng): Sure — old v1 curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoke \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -d '{"model_id":"redwood-alpha","input":"Summarize this"}'
```
New v2 curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this"}]}'
```
Add note: responses may include `metadata.stream_id` for streaming sessions.

Alexa (SE): For Dedicated/private customers, call out that some will need firewall updates (new path `/v2/*`). Also mention we will keep a redirect 6 weeks after announcement for GETs but POSTs will receive 410 unless client sets `X-Compatibility: v1` header.

Jenny (Docs): Good call — I'll add a "Network / Config" section. Also want to add a tiny JS snippet that shows a compatibility shim users can drop in:
```js
// shim: translate legacy invoke payload to v2 generate
function shimLegacyInvoke(payload){
  if(payload.model_id){
    return { model: payload.model_id.replace(/-alpha$/, '-alpha-v2'), messages: [{role:'user', content: payload.input || ''}] }
  }
  return payload
}
```

Sam (Support): Can we get a short FAQ bullet for support playbook? e.g., "If customer reports 410 on POST, ask if they are using a pinned SDK or private deployment; offer to enable temporary `X-Compatibility: v1` header for 2 weeks."

Jenny (Docs): Yes — adding Support playbook bullets and copyable troubleshooting commands.

DocsBot: PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2789 (migration-guide/draft) :github:

Ryan (Eng): I'll open a small changelog PR in the SDK repo with examples and note the param rename. Link it once ready.

Jenny (Docs): Timeline check: I need reviews by Thu EOD to hit Friday publish. Can owners please review: Ryan on API accuracy, Alexa on networking wording, Sam on support FAQ tone.

Mike (Product): I'll coordinate the announcement email and customer DRI list. Also prepping a short staged rollout: docs publish + soft-announce in-app, then public blog post + outbound comms 48 hours later.

Alexa (SE): One more ask — can we include a small snippet for Dedicated customers showing how to flip routing policy to v2 with zero-downtime? I can draft and attach a config snippet tomorrow.

Jenny (Docs): Thanks — if you drop config snippet in this thread I will slot it into the doc. Also I'll add a short migration checklist at the top: 1) update SDKs, 2) run shim for 2 weeks, 3) update firewall/path rules, 4) test streaming behavior.

Mike (Product): Great. If anyone needs extra time shout now — otherwise we'll target Fri publish. :thumbsup:

Ryan (Eng): Fine from eng side. I'll post the SDK PR link in this thread when ready.

Jenny (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2789 — draft includes code samples, FAQ, and support playbook. Please comment.

Sam (Support): I'll add 2-3 canned responses for Support and escalate playbook for high-risk customers.

Mike (Product): Thanks everyone. Follow-up sync if there are major issues, otherwise we proceed.
